data: Is the blue line representing F1_Softmax performance higher than the red line representing Acc_Softmax performance on the right side graph?

The question asks whether the blue line representing F1_Softmax performance is higher than the red line representing Acc_Softmax performance on the right side graph. 

From the analysis of the figure:

1. The blue line represents F1_Softmax performance.
2. The red line represents Acc_Softmax performance.
3. On the right side graph (b), both lines start at approximately the same point but diverge as the number of epochs increases.
4. The blue line (F1_Softmax) remains consistently above the red line (Acc_Softmax) throughout the entire range of epochs shown on the x-axis.

Therefore, the blue line representing F1_Softmax performance is indeed higher than the red line representing Acc_Softmax performance on the right side graph.
